title: The Pillage People - Level 4
description: The Pillage People - Level 4 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Pillagers there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Pillagers there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

I just found out that another tomb dedicated to the AFK Bolsheviks has been overrun by monsters. In fact, they turned it into a nightclub! Those animals! I bet the AFK Bolshevik entombed there is rolling over and doing the hustle in his grave. Although, I can't figure out if that is a good thing or a bad thing. Semantics aside, do you think you can help out in clearing the tomb of these vile Pillagers?

The Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist on Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag is where these Pillagers are pillaging. Actually, they aren't pillaging much anymore since they have basically cleared the place out, they are more like milling about pillaging the odds and ends left about. So, I guess they are more millaging than pillaging, but they still have to go! Head down to the tomb and take out 20 of these Pillagers and return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell. Buh-bye now.

Turn-in:

You have dealt with the Pillagers? Very good.

Objectives:

  • Slay Pillagers

Level range: 83–100
